# Frontier Equipment Company

> Frontier Equipment Company leases shop, pad, and man-camp space at Prudhoe Bay on Alaska's North Slope. The property, known as Frontier Pad, is a fully permitted, gravel-built industrial complex 12.5 miles west of Deadhorse on the Spine Road, inside Hilcorp security.

## What Frontier Equipment Company offers

Frontier Equipment Company provides industrial real-estate leasing on the North Slope of Alaska:

- **Shop leasing** — A 36,000 square foot primary shop plus multiple auxiliary shops, in open and enclosed service-bay configurations, fit for Arctic fleet maintenance, fabrication, equipment storage, and staging.
- **Pad leasing** — A permitted, gravel-built industrial pad inside operator (Hilcorp) security, for staging, laydown, and project mobilization. Indicative rate around $5,500 per acre per month.
- **Man-camp leasing** — A 208-bed workforce-housing camp on the same pad as the shops, suited to large crews and longer campaigns.

Tenants can lease a single shop, a block of pad, beds in the camp, or the integrated footprint together.

## Key facts

- **Location:** 12.5 miles west of Deadhorse, Alaska, on the Spine Road, inside Hilcorp security, North Slope Borough (Prudhoe Bay area).
- **Primary shop:** 36,000 sq ft, plus multiple auxiliary shops.
- **Camp:** 208 beds, on-site.
- **Access:** year-round, road-connected, gated and secure.
- **Heritage:** Frontier has operated on the North Slope since the 1970s. Under the Frontier Companies of Alaska, the company built a large share of the Slope's roads (including the Spine Road), plus docks, airstrips, camps, and shops that helped open Prudhoe Bay. In 1982 Frontier opened a $4,000,000 heavy-equipment maintenance facility at Prudhoe Bay built to service up to 23 pieces of heavy construction equipment at once. That same proven infrastructure is what Frontier Equipment Company leases today.
- **Demand drivers:** North Slope oil and gas development, Trans-Alaska Pipeline (TAPS) activity, Arctic data centers, cold-climate compute, oilfield support and service industry, and defense/sovereign Arctic infrastructure.

## Common questions

- **Where is Frontier Pad located?** 12.5 miles west of Deadhorse, Alaska, on the Spine Road, inside Hilcorp security, on the North Slope.
- **What does Frontier Equipment Company lease?** Shop space, gravel pad/yard space, and man-camp (workforce housing) beds at Prudhoe Bay.
- **How big is the shop?** A 36,000 square foot primary shop, plus multiple auxiliary shops.
- **How many camp beds?** 208 beds on-site.
- **Is the site secure and accessible year-round?** Yes. It is inside Hilcorp's security perimeter, road-connected, and operable in every season.
